main_text.head: 5. STATVS.
main_text.p: In hac prophetia Conieșturalis status obtinet: quem ut declaremus, de ὑποθέσεως & de θέσεως agemus.

Hypothefis: Si est Prouidentia, cur pa-titur Deus populum Iudaicum, quem si-bi in peculium segregauit, à sceleratis il-lis idololatris, Chaldaeis inquâ, tam cru-deliter traʃtari? Vt enim facilè dem, Iu-daeos non esse ἀναμαρτησίας: tamen quis dubitet, longè ipsis deteriores esse Baby-lonios hostes? Quo autem quisq; peior est, tanto uidetur peiore fortuna dignus.

Thesis: An ne in tantis afflictionibus & calamitatibus Ecclesiae & singulorum fidelium, ac in tanta saevitia impiorum, velut in medijs tenebris confusionū ge-neris humani, lucet aliqua Dei providen-tia, iustitia, misericordia?

Iehouah Dominus Deus noster (qui in terrogatus respondet) aietem sententiam demonstrat: & Habacucum eò adducit, ut Dei iudicia sibi adoranda & approbā-da esse, conuictus tandem statuat. Est au-tem, in disceptatione de prouidentia &

page.notes: Greek words in italics: ὑποθέσεως, θέσεως and ἀναμαρτησίας are read with [?] where uncertain. Line "(qui in / terrogatus" is printed with a break after "in"; the word is read as printed, its division unclear. Long s was replaced with plain s throughout. Several words in the first line ("cadą") are doubtful. Scan is slightly blurred at the top line.
